title: Map acoustics
description: The room sound of a map (backlog X-04): settings of the AudioEffectReverb on the world effects bus (sound_map buses.world), applied by AudioDirector when a view names the map. The file id is a map id, or 'default' for maps without their own file. Interface sounds and warnings do not pass through this bus: they stay dry.

description.description: The space, and what the reverb should sound like

reverb.description: Godot AudioEffectReverb parameters (a Freeverb-style algorithmic reverb)

damping.description: How fast the highs die in the tail (stone: low, cloth and wood: high)

hipass.description: High-pass on the reverb input, keeping the low end out of the tail (no mud); cutoff about hipass x 6 kHz (0.04 = 240 Hz)

wet.description: Tail level; the loudness rule (nothing louder than the CC warning) is checked with it through tools/audio/arena.py, a port of Godot's reverb

predelay_ms.description: Spacing of the echo Godot's reverb feeds back into its own input (it does not delay the direct sound); with predelay_feedback 0 it has no effect

predelay_feedback.description: Level of that echo: a flutter between parallel walls
